comment: Advisories that `pnpm audit --prod` reports and that the audit guard (scripts/audit-guard.mjs) accepts. Each entry needs the reason and the date it was last reviewed; the guard fails when a review is older than 180 days.

advisories.reason: Affects the authorization code flow (InteractiveBrowserCredential, AuthorizationCodeCredential). sforge only creates DefaultAzureCredential, which does not use that flow. @azure/identity 4.x requires msal-node ^6 and the fix is in 7.1.0; remove this entry when identity moves to 7.
